fuente.titulo: Pope Leo XIV prays for victims of Cairo fuel lorry explosion

titular: Pope Leo prays for victims of Cairo blast
bajada: He entrusted those who died in the fuel lorry explosion to God's mercy
caption: Pope Leo XIV has sent his condolences to the families of those killed in a fuel tanker explosion in Cairo, Egypt, entrusting the victims to God's mercy. The Pope expressed spiritual closeness to all affected by the tragedy. Source: Vatican News, Nov 27, 2026.

ilustracion.descripcion: A quiet candlelight vigil scene with an empty street in Cairo at dusk, smoke faintly rising in the background; a small cross or rosary rests in the upper right third, left and center areas open and calm.
